title: A New Family of Poisson Non-negative Matrix Factorization Methods Using the Shifted Log Link
abstract: arXiv:2601.05845v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Poisson non-negative matrix factorization (NMF) is a widely used method to find interpretable "parts-based" decompositions of count data. While many variants of Poisson NMF exist, existing methods assume that the "parts" in the decomposition combine additively. This assumption may be natural in some settings, but not in others. Here we introduce Poisson NMF with the shifted-log link function to relax this assumption. The shifted-log link function has a single tuning parameter, and as this parameter varies the model changes from assuming that parts combine additively (i.e., standard Poisson NMF) to assuming that parts combine more multiplicatively. We provide an algorithm to fit this model by maximum likelihood, and also an approximation that substantially reduces computation time for large, sparse datasets (computations scale with the number of non-zero entries in the data matrix). translated_title: 使用平移对数链接函数的泊松非负矩阵分解新方法族
translated_abstract: 泊松非负矩阵分解（NMF）是一种广泛使用的方法，用于寻找计数数据的可解释的“基于部分”的分解。虽然泊松NMF存在许多变体，但现有方法都假设分解中的“部分”以加法方式组合。这一假设在某些情况下可能是自然的，但在其他情况下则不然。在此，我们引入带有平移对数（shifted-log）链接函数的泊松NMF来放宽这一假设。平移对数链接函数具有单一调节参数，随着该参数的变化，模型从假设各部分以加法方式组合（即标准泊松NMF）转变为假设各部分更多地以乘法方式组合。我们提供了通过最大似然估计来拟合该模型的算法，还提供了一种近似方法，可大幅减少大型稀疏数据集的计算时间（计算量与数据矩阵中非零条目的数量成正比）。我们在多种真实数据集上演示了这些新方法。
tldr: 该论文提出了带平移对数链接函数的泊松非负矩阵分解新方法族，通过单一调节参数使“部分”的组合方式从加法平滑过渡到乘法，并提供了高效的最大似然算法及适用于大型稀疏数据集的快速近似方法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a new family of Poisson NMF methods with the shifted-log link, whose single tuning parameter allows parts to combine from additively to multiplicatively, together with a maximum likelihood algorithm and a fast approximation for large sparse datasets.
